The note's only correction is the mechanical detail: 'inside mouth, chewed and spit' vs 'bag over mouth.' The tweet's phrasing ('place a plastic bag over their mouth while eating') is loose but not load-bearingly wrong — it's the same harmful pseudo-dietary practice, sourced to the same Chinese trend reporting (Dexerto). 40/79 raters flagged noteNotNeeded. judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note.
